summary: John's 2nd-great-grand-uncle; associate editor of the Sunday Independent.
bio: John Vincent Heffernan (9 Jul 1886 - 1 Mar 1958), associate editor of the Sunday Independent; married Edith Corrine Graham in New York City in 1914; died at Alexandria, Virginia.
